subject: order of responses from aaply and alply

messages.author: 3b469b246ecd3a5b
messages.subject: order of responses from aaply and alply
parts:
I am trying to do what I thought was a simple aaply and realized the
order of the returned array is not what I expected. I thought these
three variations should produce results in the same order:

array_version <- aaply(ozone[1:5,,], 1, mean)
array_version[1:5]

list_version <- alply(ozone[1:5,,], 1, mean)
list_version[1:5]

for(i in 1:5) loop_version[i] <- mean(ozone[i,,])
loop_version[1:5]

What I get is that the array order of array_version is reversed but
the list_version and loop_version come out in the order I expected. Am
I wrong to be surprised?

> array_version <- aaply(ozone[1:5,,], 1, mean)
> array_version[1:5]
-21.2 -18.7 -16.2 -13.7 -11.2
257.8657 258.8148 260.6493 263.0104 266.8194
>
> list_version <- alply(ozone[1:5,,], 1, mean)
> list_version[1:5]
$`1`
[1] 266.8194

$`2`
[1] 263.0104

$`3`
[1] 260.6493

$`4`
[1] 258.8148

$`5`
[1] 257.8657


> for(i in 1:5) loop_version[i] <- mean(ozone[i,,])
> loop_version[1:5]
[1] 266.8194 263.0104 260.6493 258.8148 257.8657

I am running plyr 1.03 (at least that's what the help says. I don't
know how to get the package version directly.)

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: order of responses from aaply and alply
